levels.surface: محمد بن عمرو بن عباد بن جبلة بن أبي رواد

notes: one «ح» splits two routes; «قال شعبة حدثنا عن خالد الحذاء ...» is written once after the last «ح», so it is the shared tail of both routes
«أبيه» is a bare relation to Abu Bakra (the Companion): not identified; the Prophet is not a link
